result.instructions: Tools for Tiltify, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of my Tiltify campaigns are published right now, and how much has each raised?"; "Who are the top donors to my campaign this month?"; "Show me the donations to my campaign from the last 24 hours.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Tiltify data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run tiltify_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run tiltify_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run tiltify_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. tiltify_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: tiltify_get_current_user
tools.title: Get the signed-in Tiltify user
tools.description: Return the Tiltify user that the access token belongs to (id, slug, username, public description, social links, total amount raised). Start here to get the user_id for tiltify_list_user_campaigns. Tiltify API: GET /api/public/current-user.

tools.name: tiltify_list_user_campaigns
tools.title: List a user's campaigns
tools.description: List the campaigns of a Tiltify user: amount raised, goal, status, donate URL and cause. Filter by status (published or retired). Tiltify API: GET /api/public/users/{user_id}/campaigns.

updated_after.description: Only campaigns updated after this ISO 8601 time.

updated_before.description: Only campaigns updated before this ISO 8601 time.

after.description: Cursor: the metadata.after value of the previous page.

before.description: Cursor: the metadata.before value of the next page.

tools.name: tiltify_list_campaign_donations
tools.title: List a campaign's donations
tools.description: List donations to a campaign: amount, completed time, the public donor name and the donor's comment. Supporter contact data is not returned. Tiltify API: GET /api/public/campaigns/{campaign_id}/donations.

completed_after.description: Only donations completed after this ISO 8601 time.

completed_before.description: Only donations completed before this ISO 8601 time.

after.description: Cursor: the metadata.after value of the previous page.

before.description: Cursor: the metadata.before value of the next page.
